name: authentication-strategy-design
description: Design authentication strategy. Selects among password / MFA / SSO (SAML, OIDC, OAuth2) / passwordless (WebAuthn / magic link / passkey) / mTLS / API keys / JWT-bearer / session-cookie. Per user population (customer / employee / partner / service-to-service) chooses appropriate mechanism with threat-model rationale. Covers lifecycle (registration / auth / recovery / rotation / revocation). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
